# HALL Clock-In System: Data Dictionary

This data dictionary defines the data fields used to submit, validate, and resolve an employee clock-in request, from submission through manager review.

**Category key:** User-entered = typed by a person. Derived = looked up or calculated from other data. System-assigned = generated by the system.

| Field | Business Meaning | Type | Required? | Category | Rule / Constraint | Source | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **requestId** | Unique identifier assigned to each clock-in request so the request can be tracked through every state. | Text | Yes | System-assigned | Must be unique; generated by the system at submission; never changes once assigned | System | REQ-10025 |
| **employeeId** | Identifier the employee enters to submit a clock-in request. | Text | Yes | User-entered | Letters, numbers, and hyphens only; must match an existing employee record | Employee | EMP-10492 |
| **employeeName** | Name of the employee associated with the employee ID. | Text | Yes | Derived | Retrieved from the employee record using employeeId; not manually entered | Employee record | Jen Calderon |
| **employmentStatus** | Indicates whether the employee is currently employed and eligible to clock in. | Text | Yes | Derived | Allowed: Active, Inactive; Inactive causes the request to be Rejected (BR-6) | Employee record | Active |
| **scheduledShiftDate** | Date on which the employee is scheduled to work. | Date | Conditional | Derived | Must match a shift assigned to the employee; if no matching shift exists, the request is Rejected (BR-6) | Schedule record | 09/15/2026 |
| **scheduledShiftStart** | Time the employee is scheduled to begin the shift. | Time | Conditional | Derived | Retrieved from the employee's assigned shift; required whenever a matching shift exists | Schedule record | 8:00 AM |
| **minutesFromShiftStart** | Difference in minutes between the clock-in time and the scheduled shift start. | Integer | Conditional | Derived | Calculated as clockInTimestamp minus scheduledShiftStart. Negative = early, positive = late. Less than -15 or greater than 15 causes the request to be Flagged | System calculation | 4 |
| **hasOpenClockIn** | Indicates whether the employee already has an open clock-in that would create a duplicate or overlapping shift. | Boolean | Yes | Derived | Allowed: True, False; True causes the request to be Flagged (BR-5) | Clock-in records | False |
| **clockInStatus** | Current state of the clock-in request. | Text | Yes | System-assigned | Allowed: Submitted, Under Review, Accepted, Flagged, Rejected, Resolved; changes only through allowed state transitions | System | Accepted |
| **statusReason** | Explains why a request was Flagged or Rejected. | Text | Conditional | System-assigned | Required when clockInStatus is Flagged or Rejected | System | Clock-in more than 15 minutes late |
| **clockInTimestamp** | Date and time the clock-in request is recorded. | Date/Time | Yes | System-assigned | Recorded from the system clock at submission; cannot be entered or changed by the employee | System | 09/15/2026 8:04 AM |
| **reviewedBy** | Manager who reviewed a Flagged or Rejected request. | Text | Conditional | System-assigned | Required when clockInStatus is Resolved; must be a valid manager ID; captured from the logged-in manager | System | MGR-2041 |
| **managerDecision** | Outcome of the manager's review. | Text | Conditional | User-entered (manager) | Allowed: Approved, Denied; required when clockInStatus is Resolved | Manager | Approved |
| **resolutionNote** | Manager's explanation for the review decision. | Text | Conditional | User-entered (manager) | Required when clockInStatus is Resolved | Manager | Late arrival due to approved schedule change |
| **resolvedAt** | Date and time the manager completed the review. | Date/Time | Conditional | System-assigned | Required when clockInStatus is Resolved; recorded from the system clock; must be later than clockInTimestamp | System | 09/15/2026 9:30 AM |

## Notes

- **Authoritative rules:** Employment status, shift matching, duplicate detection, and the 15-minute timing window are enforced in the application tier, not only in the browser.

- **Audit requirement:** Every Flagged or Rejected request must record reviewedBy, managerDecision, resolutionNote, and resolvedAt before it can move to Resolved.

- **Timestamps:** clockInTimestamp and resolvedAt come only from the system clock so records cannot be backdated.

- **Week 6 test input:** The minutes-from-shift-start field on the page is a test stand-in. In the production system, minutesFromShiftStart is calculated by the system, not entered by the employee.
